framing.title: One border, different signals
framing.subtitle: Selected indicators of economic activity and mobility; these are not matched city outcomes or resilience scores.
framing.display_rule: Separate charts and labelled units. Never compare bar lengths across different metrics, populations or years; no composite score.

hong_kong.label: Retail company count
hong_kong.verification: Reused previously verified same-series local economic-evidence.json.
hong_kong.caveat: Cross-sectional company counts, not closures or a fixed cohort; no causal attribution to northbound spending.

shenzhen.label: HK and Macao overnight visitor-trips
shenzhen.verification: Primary page read directly in this research pass.
shenzhen.caveat: Hong Kong and Macao combined; excludes day visitors. Trips, not unique visitors, spending or gains to local firms.
shenzhen.chart: Single count bar from zero with a +26.6% year-on-year annotation; do not invent an exact 2024 count by reversing the rounded rate.

economy.comparison_caveat: The Hong Kong chart measures firms in 2023–2024; the Shenzhen chart measures a visitor subgroup in 2025. These illustrate distinct pressures and opportunities, not a measured transfer or net city benefit.

mobility.label: Hong Kong-resident departures via direct Shenzhen boundary points
mobility.short_label: HK-resident departures across the Shenzhen boundary
mobility.derivation: Analyst sum of the seven named control-point rows, published in thousands. 2025 sum = 85,824 thousand; 2024 sum = 75,333 thousand. Approximately 86 million is valid for this bounded subset.
mobility.verification: Primary PDF table text read directly; screenshot request also completed.
mobility.chart: Two zero-baseline bars, 75.3m and 85.8m; seven-control-point breakdown can appear on hover.
caveats: Departure movements, not unique people, shoppers or commuters.
The counted crossings enter Shenzhen; final destinations and trip purposes are unknown.
Excludes West Kowloon high-speed rail and Hong Kong–Zhuhai–Macao Bridge; do not label this all land departures.
Counts do not measure waiting time, reliability, fairness, belonging or resilience.
Totals are sums of rounded published counts.
mobility.claim_decision: Replace the vague 86m northbound land departures claim with the precisely bounded short label above.

connection.verification: Prior verification supplied by parent; no new effect size researched.
connection.chart_rule: Sample size may be a labelled study-sample icon array, never a citywide effect or comparison score. Prefer an explicit evidence-gap treatment for citywide connection/participation.

design_recommendation.layout: Three graphic scenes/tabs: economy has two clearly independent mini charts; mobility has a two-year count comparison; connection shows bounded study evidence and a visible evidence gap.
avoid: Common metric axis for retail firms and visitors
